verdict.rationale: doola documents a Partner API for creating customers, submitting LLC/C-Corp formations, retrieving documents, looking up reference data, and filing compliance and annual reports. It also offers sandbox keys, idempotent retries, machine-readable error codes, signed webhooks, self-service key management, and an llms.txt index, which together make it drivable programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), access appears gated to Partner Portal accounts rather than fully open, and no independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
